title: Importers, verified end-to-end
notes: The XenForo, phpBB, Discourse and vBulletin importers now have automated end-to-end tests that run each one against a sample database of that platform, verifying members, categories, topics, posts and formatting all map across correctly.

changelog.text: XenForo, phpBB, Discourse & vBulletin importers are now covered by automated end-to-end mapping tests.
Tightened importer handling of deleted/hidden threads, private messages, bot accounts and table prefixes.
